icons.post: alpha fringe cleanup, square re-centre with 9% margin, 640 px
icons.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: hero illustration for a tile in a premium desktop creative-production app, shown at 120 to 260 px on a dark, colourful gradient card.
Subject: a neat chunky glossy 3D grid of four rounded square tiles arranged two by two with small gaps, each tile a different soft colour, suggesting all categories together.
Style/medium: premium 3D render in the style of modern macOS app illustrations such as CleanMyMac: soft rounded chunky forms, glossy and satin materials, subtle frosted glass, gentle iridescent highlights, smooth subsurface sheen, crisp clean bevels, simple and iconic with no clutter.
Composition/framing: one single object, centred, three-quarter view from slightly above and slightly left, the object fills about 78% of the square canvas with an even transparent margin on all sides, entire object visible and not cropped.
Lighting/mood: bright soft studio key light from the upper left, soft fill, subtle cool rim light, luminous and optimistic.
Color palette: multicolour tiles: coral, teal, violet and amber, balanced; rich and saturated but not neon; deeper tones on the sides for depth.
Constraints: transparent background with real alpha, no ground plane, no floor shadow, no pedestal, no background scene, no frame or border, no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.
Avoid: flat vector style, emoji style, photorealistic photo look, tiny fussy details, generic yellow folder.
